track_name: Oulton Park Circuit - Intl w/out Brittens
title: Track Guide Oulton Park Int W/O brittens Toyota GR86 iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: brake at banner on left, 40% pressure, ease off before curb
corners.line: take a lot of curb, flat, exit to outside curb
corners.exit: throttle up before curb, keep one wheel within white line
corners.mistakes: touching grass causes car to bounce around, going outside white line gets 1x

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: brake after dip, 50% pressure, ease off before end of inside wall
corners.line: set up right, apex at end of wall, fully on curb
corners.exit: throttle up before curb, stay within white lines
corners.mistakes: going outside white line with half car gets 1x

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: Brake at end of tire wall, 85% pressure, easing off to middle of corner.
corners.line: Get close to inside curb, pick up throttle in middle of corner.
corners.exit: Maintain left side of track, avoid outside curb.
corners.mistakes: Don't go over outside curb, grass hurts lap time.

corners.label: T7
corners.braking: Brake at 100 board and 50 board, 95% pressure, easing off to first inside wall.
corners.exit: Add throttle before curb, hit brake 20% to help turn.

corners.label: T9
corners.braking: Lift just a little bit after turn in.
corners.exit: Full throttle, use every inch of room on outside.

corners.label: T12
corners.braking: Brake at color change, 50% pressure, trail brake to first curb.
corners.line: Cut curb, use outside curb to carry speed.
corners.exit: Throttle on exit, use outside curb.

corners.label: T13
corners.braking: Brake at color change, 95% pressure, ease off to emergency road.
corners.exit: Throttle on exit, use outside curb.

general_tips: be as far right as possible for turn three setup
get in close to inside curb for turn four exit
gradually increase throttle for turn five exit
Be on the left side of the track for qualifying.
